annotations.title: Set a shareable invite link’s fees

description: Use this when the user wants investors who join through a shareable invite link to start on different fees. Starts setting the link’s fees: the class’s default, another template, or new terms. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed fees for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise
